source.name: The FA - Emirates FA Cup competition page footer sponsors

note: Cognizant appears in the FA Cup page's secondary-sponsor footer alongside Carling, Emirates, Mitre and ClearScore (fetched 25 Sep 2026). Its exact FA Cup role is not stated on the page; Cognizant is a long-standing FA digital transformation partner per a 13 Sep 2023 TheFA.com announcement ('The FA and Cognizant expand Digital Transformation Partnership', seen only via Google News - headline source not openable, see unsourced). Cognizant already exists in normalized as a rated sponsor (concern).
